activation_requires: Exact firmware, executable variant, region identity and binding ABI
Independent complete-state, memory and real-effect equivalence
Exact partial-grant, fault, interrupt and deadline behavior
Measured instrument benefit with startup reported separately

candidates.operation: Lower the five compiler shift loops to bounded native integer operations
candidates.constraints: Raw byte counts, zero and oversized counts, carry/flags, A/Y residue, stack and exact interrupted prefixes; avoid C++ oversized-shift undefined behavior

candidates.operation: Resolve validated immutable inline tables to direct native branches
candidates.constraints: Consume the real saved return word, preserve default and raw index behavior plus register/stack effects; table data is not executable code

candidates.operation: Fuse buffered display command interpretation, byte reads/writes and address selection into direct owner RAM operations
candidates.constraints: Guard actual buffering flag at 0x1815; preserve page/column at 0x1849/0x1848, byte wrapping, mode differences, command ordering and architectural residue; physical mode retains real transactions

candidates.operation: Fuse set/clear/XOR pixel and masked pixel read with the buffered display bindings
candidates.constraints: 128x64 bounds; page=7-(y>>3), bit=0x80>>(y&7); mode 1 clears, 2 toggles, all other writer modes set; return raw masked read, preserve A/X, cursor, flags and actual stack effects

candidates.operation: Fuse page-mask rectangle fills and full buffered frame clears into native loops
candidates.constraints: Guard buffered mode; preserve signed height, right-edge clipping, zero dimensions, mode-dependent cursor effects, per-page ordering and intermediate boundaries; do not apply a generic rectangle API

candidates.operation: Lower length and forward zero-terminated copy loops over proven ordinary RAM
candidates.constraints: Preserve 16-bit wrap, original forward overlap, terminator access, pointer/stack residue and nontermination/fault behavior; no unbounded host strlen/strcpy on guest storage

candidates.operation: Lower byte-sample display interpolation and its shift helpers as a fused integer expression
candidates.constraints: Byte index wrap, both actual reads, weights summing to 2^count-1, 16-bit product/sum wrap, signed shift and raw oversized counts

candidates.operation: Lower the 32-word X-to-Y bus pipeline to a specialized native transfer loop
candidates.constraints: 34 real input reads, scale-dependent full accumulator stores, retained final A/B and R0/R5, X/Y alias and modulo behavior; not a generic memcpy

candidates.operation: Lower adjacent fixed-point pair sums and duplication over 32 in-place words
candidates.constraints: Full accumulator addition, limited/scaled transfer, original preload/store order, all remaining registers/flags and modifiers; do not average pairs

candidates.operation: Lower one original effect-clear step to native zeroing loops and callback publication
candidates.constraints: 512 ring plus 32 output words per linear-modifier call, exact advanced cursor and ready callback threshold; preserve Multi staging alias and inter-call live updates; never eagerly clear the whole ring

candidates.operation: Lower the sixteen-sample recursive fixed-point filter into an optimized native kernel
candidates.constraints: Original 56-bit accumulation, 24-bit limiting, SR scale/round modes, aliased in-place operation, seventeenth input prefetch/history repair, exact final AGU/register/flag/loop state and prefixes

candidates.operation: Lower the gain and recursive stereo output block with native owner RAM and output bindings
candidates.constraints: Read actual gain at X:0x17, 33 X inputs for 32 outputs, retained Y prefetch, paired histories and integer residual at zero gain; preserve publication boundaries and final full accumulators

candidates.operation: Fuse shaped resident-frame interpolation, morphing and distinct FM/audio output stores
candidates.constraints: Exact 128-word modulo state, phase shaping, full interpolants, limited terms, quarter-gain shifts, borrowed modifier restoration and original continuation; no floating-point interpolation substitute

candidates.operation: Fuse the sixteen-byte response reader with an equivalent concrete host transaction
candidates.constraints: Original J0 sequence and sixteen distinct Port Q reads, message order, partial effects, fault position, IRQ/time/backpressure and X/Y residue; a copied cached response is not equivalent
